consumer: An offline combat-log analysis script that asks 'what is each monster's true raw current HP integer right now?'
scope: Per-entity raw authoritative HP for each nearby monster, independent of visibility/seen-state or any display filtering
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(monsters) writes mon.get_hp()/get_hp_max() straight from the engine getters, reading the raw world-state HP integer rather than a computed predicate or display view
divergence: A monster currently out of the player's line of sight (unseen) but actively losing HP from a fire/bleed field: raw state still reports its true decremented HP, whereas a display/observability proxy (what the GUI last remembered) would lag and report a stale value
